Notifier.//WebBase: Where iPop Notifier opens iPop pages in the browser (the public web address, not the API host).

Synology.//ChatFolder: Must be a shared folder, NOT /home — /home resolves to the logged-in account's own home, which no other chat participant can read.
Synology.//ServiceAccount: Credentials come from appsettings.Local.json (git-ignored) or env vars Synology__ServiceAccount__Username / __Password.
